# RAV (Rive Animation Viewer) - llms.txt

site_name: RAV
site_url: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/
canonical_url: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/
owner: IVG Design
last_updated: 2026-08-15
language: en

## Purpose
RAV is a standalone desktop app for inspecting, debugging, and testing Rive (.riv) files offline. Version 2.4.3 is the current public release and is available through the normal updater feed.

## Canonical Sources
- Home: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/
- Documentation: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs
- Changelog: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/changelog

## Core Feature Anchors
- ViewModel controls: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#viewmodel-controls
- ViewModel lists use a direct authored name or one unique canonical-string match; ambiguous items become `Row N`, and generic `viewModelName` identifiers are never shown as authored labels: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/viewmodel-controls
- Each image property uses one full-width select containing every embedded raster asset, Open file, and Clear; the external file input stays hidden, with no separate action buttons and standalone parity: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/viewmodel-controls
- Event console: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#event-console
- Script console: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#script-console
- Transparency mode: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#transparency-mode
- Standalone export: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#standalone-export
- Applied editor config and lifecycle callbacks are preserved and executed in standalone exports: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/script-editor
- macOS .riv declarations cover the official Rive UTI and legacy RAV compatibility UTI, include the dedicated document icon resource, and register RAV as a Viewer without default takeover: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/opening-files
- Windows NSIS and MSI packages ship a dedicated multi-resolution .riv icon; installs and updates own the matching document-icon value, while uninstall cleanup preserves the association that preceded RAV: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/opening-files
- RAV defaults to runtime 2.39.2 because 2.40.0 has a confirmed nested-image double-offset in both Canvas and WebGL2; Latest/2.40.0 remain warned explicit opt-ins: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/configuration
- Fixed canvases use overflow-safe auto margins to stay centered while they fit and preserve authored-origin scrolling when oversized: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/ui-layout
